title: Grof's book: discarnate aliens would show up as hallucinations

tellings.quote: Grath actually in one of his books he said look if if there are advanced intelligent beings you know aliens that are kind of non-physical discarnate

plain: The idea is that if there are advanced alien beings with no physical body, people would meet them as what look like hallucinations. A neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore, who studies the psychedelic drug DMT, tells Michels that the author Stanislav Grof made this point in one of his books, which Gallimore does not name. If so, some drug visions might be contact with real minds rather than tricks of the brain.
